senses.gloss: m. (v. חַזּוּר) [little apple,] crab-apple (Malus Coronaria), similar yet heterogeneous to apple.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:4">Kil. I, 4</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="H00564"><he>חזרד</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>חַזְרָרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 2:1:20">Y. Ter. II, 41ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>קטנות כח׳</he> (not <he>בח׳</he>) as small as crab-apples; (Y. Sabb. III, 5ᵈ <he>כחוז׳</he>; Bab.
